    Naming your Templar

    The Templar is Aion 2's dedicated tank: armored, shield in hand, built for damage mitigation and keeping enemies' attention on themselves. Templar names traditionally sound knightly and dependable. Think of a holy order, a sworn guardian or the last wall before the healer.

    The generator mixes Templar-flavored roots such as Aeg-, Val-, Ald- and Ser- with endings like -ric, -ard and -ius, which gives names like Aldric, Valerius or Serion. The Epic compound tone builds shield-themed names: Dawnward, Silveroath and Grimbastion.

    Quick tips

    • Names ending in -ric, -ard and -ius carry a classic paladin and knight feel.
    • For Asmodian Templars, pair dark words with protective ones: Duskguard, Ashwall.
    • A calm, readable name is easy for your party to call out during a pull.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What are some cool Templar names for Aion 2?

    Try Aldric, Valerion, Aegisar, Dawnward or Ravenshield. Lock the class to Templar in the generator above to get a fresh batch every click.

    Is the Templar a tank in Aion 2?

    Yes. The Templar is the main tank class, known for heavy defense, damage mitigation and aggro control, which is why this generator leans toward protective, honorable names.

    How do I use the Templar name generator?

    The class is already set to Templar. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
